construction.exact_sector_gluing: Z_h(Q)=sum_bar_u sum_(a xor b=h) W_A,a(Q_A,bar_u+h e_s) W_B,b(Q_B,Q_S-bar_u-h e_s)
construction.interpretation: sector-specific reindexing of the exact interface sum, not a physical current coupling

fixed_geometric_path_transport.action_distortion: Even among Q-preserving states, toggling an all-zero versus all-one length-(L-1) horizontal path has reciprocal weight ratios (p/(1-p))^(L-1) and ((1-p)/p)^(L-1); no size-uniform distortion bound exists for p!=1/2.

acceptance_outcome.reason: Aligned supports overlap and bar_d_Q<1 on many finite records, but risk-weighted aligned TV remains 0.723-0.792 of R_L on L3 and 0.791-0.863 on L4. The two sizes do not support decay, and the one-hot reindexing has no Q-preserving, bounded-distortion state transport.

decision: Retain bar_U_s only as an exact parity-aligned algebraic state. Do not call it a mixing coupling. The next discriminating theorem must construct a record-dependent residual-path transport with controlled multiplicity and action distortion, or prove that such uniform control is impossible.
claim_boundary: Finite exact controls validate nontrivial support alignment but neither show nor refute thermodynamic contraction. Anchor minima are reported diagnostically and are not selected for promotion.
